brand.name: alpha-fit
brand.aesthetic: Apex Predator / Intensified Cyber Athletic. Metallic chrome, electric blue glow, pitch black background, sharp geometries, shield/badge motifs.

surfaces.premium_cards: bg-gradient-to-b from-[#0A0A10] to-[#000000] border border-[#00BFFF] relative

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Dense and intense. Use Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Exposed grid lines in dashboards.

buttons.primary: bg-[#00BFFF] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-[#00E5FF] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,229,255,0.6)] transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#00BFFF] text-[#00BFFF] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-[#00BFFF]/10 transition-all duration-300
buttons.premium: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1E90FF] to-[#00BFFF] text-black font-bold uppercase hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,191,255,0.8)] transition-all duration-300 relative overflow-hidden

badges.styling: metallic sheen, sharp geometric edges (hexagon or shield), electric blue glow core, chrome borders. Use intense box-shadows.

inputs.styling: bg-[#0A0A10] border-b-2 border-[#1A1A24] text-white focus:border-[#00BFFF] focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 transition-colors rounded-none px-4 py-3

active_workout_session.styling: Full-screen mode. Pitch black background. Massive numbers (Teko text-8xl) for rest timers. Glowing circular progress indicators. Swipe/Auto-advance logic.

icons.style: Use sharp/technical icons. Stroke width 2 or 2.5 for better visibility.

hero_backgrounds.description: A man hanging upside down in the dark - perfect for intense, elite landing page backgrounds.
Blue and black background with swirls - use as texture overlay for premium plans.

equipment_imagery.description: Black and white dumbbell - use for workout list thumbnails.

media_assets.badges: DO NOT USE placeholders. Construct badges using pure CSS/Tailwind (Lucide Icon + Hexagon shape + metallic gradient background + intense blue box-shadow).

key_features_implementation_notes.ai_coach: Chat interface should look like a HUD terminal. AI messages in chrome silver, User messages bordered with electric blue.
key_features_implementation_notes.premium_paywall: Highlight the 1-year plan. Use 'Tracing Beam' effect around the recommended plan container.
key_features_implementation_notes.admin_dashboard: Use 'Control Room' grid mode. High density. Data charts using Recharts with neon blue strokes.
key_features_implementation_notes.onboarding: Step-by-step wizard. Progress bar is a bright cyan neon line.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Pure black #000000 for backgrounds, not generic grays.
Do NOT use standard rounded cards everywhere. Use sharp geometric edges or very subtle rounding to maintain the alpha/aggressive feel.
Apply `drop-shadow` for glowing text and icons to match the metallic/electric vibe.
Use framer-motion for heavy, impactful transitions. Fast snap animations, no slow bouncing.
Use standard Shadcn components but heavily restyle them. Remove default borders, apply neon blue borders and black backgrounds.
For the active workout, implement a full-screen mode that locks orientation if possible, using huge typography for timers.
